definitions.explanation: A fundamental building block in electronics or technology, such as a transistor, diode, or sensor. Refers to a discrete functional unit within a larger system.

examples.japanese: {半導体|はんどうたい}{素子|そし}の{性能|せいのう}が{向上|こうじょう}した。
examples.english: The performance of semiconductor devices has improved.

examples.japanese: この{回路|かいろ}は{複数|ふくすう}の{素子|そし}で{構成|こうせい}されている。
examples.english: This circuit is composed of multiple components.

examples.japanese: {受光|じゅこう}{素子|そし}がカメラのセンサーの{中心的|ちゅうしんてき}な{役割|やくわり}を{果|は}たす。
examples.english: The photosensitive element plays a central role in the camera sensor.

notes:
Composed of {素|そ} (element, base) and {子|し} (small thing, child). In electronics and physics, {素子|そし} refers to an individual functional component. The character {子|し} here functions as a suffix indicating a small discrete unit, similar to its use in {粒子|りゅうし} (particle) or {電子|でんし} (electron).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {半導体|はんどうたい}{素子|そし}: semiconductor device
- {受光|じゅこう}{素子|そし}: light-receiving element, photosensor
- {発光|はっこう}{素子|そし}: light-emitting element
- {素子|そし}の{集積|しゅうせき}: integration of components

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {部品|ぶひん}: part, component — a general word for mechanical or electronic parts
- {要素|ようそ}: element, factor — used more abstractly for constituent elements of a concept or system
- {電子|でんし}: electron — shares the {子|し} suffix but refers specifically to the subatomic particle
